examples.label: Day, week or month with a sliding highlight
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-headless-floating-indicator" site="Global" id="range-picker" active="week" label="Range" class="relative inline-flex gap-1 rounded-lg bg-current/10 p-1 text-sm" indicator_class="absolute top-0 left-0 rounded-md bg-current/15 transition-all duration-200" target_class="relative z-10 rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 font-medium opacity-70 aria-pressed:opacity-100"><:target value="day">Day</:target><:target value="week">Week</:target><:target value="month">Month</:target></.component>

examples.label: Two-way toggle
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-headless-floating-indicator" site="Global" id="theme-picker" active="light" label="Theme" class="relative inline-flex gap-1 rounded-lg bg-current/10 p-1 text-sm" indicator_class="absolute top-0 left-0 rounded-md bg-current/15 transition-all duration-200" target_class="relative z-10 rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 font-medium opacity-70 aria-pressed:opacity-100"><:target value="light">Light</:target><:target value="dark">Dark</:target></.component>
